# VOGLER CONSULTING

> Swiss consulting firm for AI, agentic AI, analytics, and data. We run AI roadmap and use-case discovery engagements, build custom agents, deep agentic systems, data applications and enterprise RAG deployments, and deliver hands-on workshops for organisations in DACH. Cloud, sovereign cloud, or on-premises.

## Consulting

- [Services overview](https://vogler-consulting.ch/en/services): All consulting services and workshops.
- [AI Roadmap](https://vogler-consulting.ch/en/services/ai-roadmap): From business goals to a sequenced AI roadmap, with target architecture, operating model, and governance.
- [Custom use-case discovery](https://vogler-consulting.ch/en/services/use-case-discovery): Opportunity mapping, feasibility, risk, and a prioritised backlog.
- [Custom AI agents](https://vogler-consulting.ch/en/services/custom-agentic-frameworks): Agents and agent systems tailored to a domain, with quality metrics and observability.
- [Personal AI assistants](https://vogler-consulting.ch/en/services/agentic-install-optimization): Secure assistants on your own device or in controlled cloud, reachable on the go.
- [Deep agentic systems](https://vogler-consulting.ch/en/services/deep-agentic-systems): Autonomous research and software development, harness architecture, and the practice to run it.
- [Data apps & pipelines](https://vogler-consulting.ch/en/services/end-to-end-delivery): Data-science and analytics applications, pipelines, and data products, built and operated end-to-end.
- [Enterprise RAG deployment](https://vogler-consulting.ch/en/services/enterprise-rag): Grounded, citable answers across your document corpus, with access control.
